body: Packaging apps/desktop with electron-builder fails: 'packages/chart/ARCHITECTURE.md must be under apps/desktop/'. Cause: pnpm symlinks workspace deps (@filemark/*) into node_modules; electron-builder's asar packer follows the symlinks out of appDir into the monorepo. Tightening asarUnpack/files globs is NOT enough. Real fixes (pick one, do in task-desk-package): (a) pnpm deploy --filter=@filemark/desktop to a flat dir then electron-builder there; (b) node-linker=hoisted for the app; (c) bundle deps so node_modules isn't needed at runtime. electron-vite build itself is fine; libsql native install under electron-builder DID complete (arch=arm64) so the ABI is de-risked — this is purely a pnpm↔electron-builder file-collection issue.
title: electron-builder + pnpm symlinked workspace: asar traversal escapes appDir
